changeSet.author: lifefit-architecture
changeSet.comment: Ticket: LF-0019. User fitness profile, goals, measurements, and body-scan metadata. A profile belongs to one user inside one tenant, so personal and gym workspaces stay separate. Measurements are append-only history. Scan rows store an object-storage key, not a file. Index review: unique profile and nutrition-style user/tenant keys; IX_FitnessGoals_User_Status for the active-goal list; IX_BodyMeasurements_User_Date and IX_BodyScanRecords_User_Date for history. No index on every measurement column. Performance note: dashboard and history queries lead with UserId and TenantId.

rollback.sql: DROP TABLE app.BodyScanRecords; DROP TABLE app.BodyMeasurements; DROP TABLE app.FitnessGoals; DROP TABLE app.FitnessProfiles;
